title: Clinical Phenotyping of Individuals with Marbach-Schaaf neurodevelopmental syndrome (MASNS)
summary:
The purpose of this study is to understand the different physical and medical challenges faced by individuals with Marbach-Schaaf syndrome. There will be tests to check the individuals´ pain tolerance, motor and cognitive function, and hormone and metabolic system.
In the future, this may help physicians better understand the condition caused by pathogenic variants in the PRKAR1B-gene. It may help them identify certain conditions before symptoms arise.
The data gathered from all participants will be summarized and evaluated. Eventually it will be published for the scientific community, hopefully allowing us to gain a better understanding of the Marbach-Schaaf syndrome.

interventions.name: The study is planned to be conducted at the Genetics Clinic of Heidelberg University Hospital. Patients with a previously diagnosed pathogenic variant of PRKAR1B, along with their parents or legal guardians, will be invited to participate.
